description: macOS regenerable ML/AI/data-science caches, model stores, package manager package caches, experiment logs, and language data caches under $HOME. Models and installed toolchains are medium or report-only; disposable download/build caches are low or medium. Prefer contents-only deletes, age gates, and native cleaners (hf cache prune, conda clean, uv cache clean, poetry cache clear) when available.

risk_policy.models_weights: medium or report-only (large re-downloads; may be intentionally kept offline)
risk_policy.experiment_run_logs: medium (user may want history; not pure cache)
risk_policy.jupyter_checkpoints: medium, careful (may hold unsaved notebook work)

rules.name: Hugging Face Hub model/dataset snapshots
rules.notes: Default HF hub cache (~/.cache/huggingface/hub). Large model blobs/snapshots; regenerable via re-download. Prefer hf cache prune/rm. HF_HOME / HF_HUB_CACHE override. Do not delete tokens under ~/.cache/huggingface/token or ~/.huggingface/token.

rules.name: Hugging Face datasets cache
rules.notes: Processed datasets cache (HF_DATASETS_CACHE). Re-download/reprocess on next load.

rules.name: Transformers legacy cache
rules.notes: Legacy TRANSFORMERS_CACHE layout; modern stack uses hub/. Safe regenerable weights/tokenizers.

rules.name: Hugging Face modules, xet, and assets caches
rules.notes: Secondary HF caches: dynamic modules, xet chunk/shard cache, library assets, evaluate/metrics. Safer than hub models; still regenerable.

rules.name: PyTorch hub and checkpoints
rules.notes: Torch Hub default $TORCH_HOME/hub or ~/.cache/torch/hub. Includes torchvision model weights under hub/checkpoints. Large but regenerable.

rules.name: PyTorch extensions and inductor/compile caches
rules.notes: Compiled C++/CUDA/MPS extensions and torch.compile/inductor artifacts. Rebuild on next use.

rules.name: Triton compiler cache
rules.notes: Triton autotune/compile cache used by some torch stacks.

rules.name: TensorFlow Datasets download cache
rules.notes: TFDS_DATA_DIR default often ~/tensorflow_datasets. Downloaded/extracted datasets; regenerable.

rules.name: Keras datasets and models cache
rules.notes: Keras get_file datasets and pretrained models under ~/.keras. Models re-download; keep if offline work expected.

rules.name: TensorFlow Hub module cache
rules.notes: TFHUB_CACHE_DIR; default often tempfile/tfhub_modules. Regenerable Hub modules.

rules.name: Apple MLX local caches
rules.notes: MLX/mlx-lm primarily reuse Hugging Face hub; extra local MLX caches if present. Large weights should be treated like HF hub (medium).

rules.name: Ollama pulled models (report-only)
rules.notes: macOS stores models under ~/.ollama/models (blobs+manifests). Very large; user-managed. Report size only; reclaim via ollama rm. Do not bulk-delete config without user intent.

rules.name: Ollama logs and app cache
rules.notes: Logs and Electron/app caches only; not model weights.

rules.name: LM Studio models (report-only)
rules.notes: Default models dir ~/.lmstudio/models (publisher/model/*.gguf). Report-only; large GGUF/MLX downloads.

rules.name: LM Studio caches and working data
rules.notes: App caches/logs; exclude chat history/settings under Application Support root unless age-gated and opt-in.

rules.name: GPT4All models (report-only)
rules.notes: macOS models dir per GPT4All docs. Report-only large model files.

rules.name: llama.cpp / ggml related caches
rules.notes: Common user/cache locations for llama.cpp tooling; models are often user-specified paths (no single standard). Medium risk for weight-sized files.

rules.name: OpenAI Whisper model cache
rules.notes: openai-whisper download_root default ~/.cache/whisper. faster-whisper often uses HF hub; dedicated caches if present.

rules.name: Sentence-Transformers cache
rules.notes: Embedding model cache; often also under HF hub. Regenerable.

rules.name: Diffusers / diffusion model cache extras
rules.notes: Diffusers primarily use HF hub; extra diffusers caches if present. Large.

rules.name: Jupyter notebook checkpoints (careful)
rules.notes: CAREFUL: .ipynb_checkpoints can hold only-unsaved recovery copies. Never default-enable full-home walk; prefer known project roots or aged checkpoints only. This rule lists home-level checkpoint dir if used; project trees need bounded scan.

rules.name: Jupyter runtime and kernel caches
rules.notes: Runtime connection files and disposable kernel metadata. Do not wipe custom nbextensions configs wholesale without care (~/.jupyter).

rules.name: IPython logs, pid, and cache dirs
rules.notes: Disposable profile subdirs. History (history.sqlite) is user data; keep out of default low-risk clean or gate separately.

rules.name: Matplotlib font and cache
rules.notes: Font list and image caches; fully regenerable.

rules.name: Seaborn and Plotly caches
rules.notes: Plot libraries cache fonts/datasets/temp. Seaborn often uses matplotlib; plotly may use ~/.plotly.

rules.name: R package and renv caches
rules.notes: R binary/package caches and renv global cache. Installed user libraries (~/Library/R, R_LIBS_USER) are not pure cache; prefer report or medium only for caches.

rules.name: Julia depot packages and artifacts (report/medium)
rules.notes: JULIA_DEPOT_PATH default ~/.julia. packages/artifacts/compiled are large; reinstall via Pkg. Report-only by default; compiled/logs could be medium if split later.

rules.name: Conda package download cache (pkgs)
rules.notes: tarballs/extracted pkgs only. Prefer conda clean -a / mamba clean. Do not delete envs/ directories (not listed). Paths vary by installer location.

rules.name: Mamba / micromamba caches
rules.notes: Standalone mamba/micromamba package caches when not sharing conda root pkgs.

rules.name: Pixi / rattler package cache
rules.notes: prefix.dev pixi uses rattler cache (macOS often Library/Caches/rattler). Regenerable downloads.

rules.name: uv package cache
rules.notes: Astral uv wheel/source cache. Prefer uv cache clean. Safe regenerable.

rules.name: uv managed Python and tools (report-only)
rules.notes: Installed interpreters/tools (uv python dir / tool dir), not disposable cache. Report-only.

rules.name: Poetry download cache
rules.notes: poetry cache clear --all. Wheel/artifact cache only.

rules.name: Poetry virtualenvs (report-only)
rules.notes: Project virtualenvs; deleting breaks envs until poetry install. Report-only.

rules.name: pyenv installed versions (report-only)
rules.notes: Installed CPython builds. Report-only; use pyenv uninstall.

rules.name: pyenv build/download cache
rules.notes: Source tarballs/build cache for pyenv install; not installed versions.

rules.name: pip wheel/HTTP cache
rules.notes: pip cache purge. Wheels/HTTP only; not virtualenvs.

rules.name: scikit-learn data and joblib cache
rules.notes: fetch_* datasets under ~/scikit_learn_data; joblib memory caches. Regenerable.

rules.name: Weights & Biases cache
rules.notes: WANDB_CACHE_DIR default ~/.cache/wandb (artifacts cache). Prefer wandb artifact cache cleanup.

rules.name: Weights & Biases local run logs
rules.notes: Offline/local run directories (often also ./wandb in projects). Medium: may hold experiment history user wants.

rules.name: MLflow local tracking store
rules.notes: Default file store ./mlruns often under cwd; home-level mlruns/.mlflow if used. Medium experiment data.

rules.name: TensorBoard logs and info
rules.notes: Event logs and .tensorboard-info; project runs/ also common. Medium: training curves may matter.

rules.name: DVC cache (report-only)
rules.notes: DVC content-addressed cache can be large and shared across projects. Report-only; use dvc gc. Project .dvc/cache not home-walked here.

rules.name: Comet and Neptune local caches
rules.notes: Experiment tracking offline caches/config. Avoid wiping API keys/config blindly; prefer cache subdirs when known.

rules.name: PyTorch Lightning logs and cache
rules.notes: Default lightning_logs often under cwd; home-level if configured. Checkpoints may live here: medium.

rules.name: Ray session and results
rules.notes: Ray temp sessions under /tmp/ray or $TMPDIR/ray; tune results in ~/ray_results. Safe after jobs finish; age-gate.

rules.name: Dask configuration spill and cache
rules.notes: Dask worker spill dirs and local caches. Config in ~/.dask may include dask.yaml; prefer cache/spill paths for delete.

rules.name: Spark local warehouse and Ivy cache
rules.notes: Local metastore warehouse and Ivy dependency caches for Spark. Regenerable jars; warehouse may hold tables: medium.

rules.name: DuckDB and Polars temp/cache
rules.notes: Engine temps and small caches. Do not delete user .duckdb database files that are primary data stores if co-located; prefer temp/cache paths.

rules.name: Parquet/Arrow temp and cache
rules.notes: Transient parquet/arrow spill files under cache/temp.

rules.name: NLTK, Gensim, spaCy data caches
rules.notes: Downloaded corpora/models. spaCy models also via pip; these are data dirs.

rules.name: fastai data and model cache
rules.notes: fastai data/archive/model dirs under ~/.fastai.

rules.name: CLIP / OpenCLIP caches
rules.notes: CLIP weight caches outside or alongside HF hub.

rules.name: Kaggle API datasets cache
rules.notes: Downloaded competition/dataset files. Do NOT touch ~/.kaggle/kaggle.json credentials.

rules.name: Numba compiled function cache
rules.notes: NUMBA_CACHE_DIR compiled bytecode; regenerable.

rules.name: ChromaDB and local vector store caches
rules.notes: Local vector DB files may be project data; treat as medium, not default low.

rules.name: LangChain / LlamaIndex caches
rules.notes: LLM framework embedding/index caches; may embed project knowledge: medium.

rules.name: vLLM cache
rules.notes: vLLM compilation/model-related cache if present on macOS/remote mounts.

rules.name: Jan / AnythingLLM local data (report-only)
rules.notes: Desktop local-LLM apps store models and chat DBs. Report-only.

rules.name: Detectron2, Fairseq, Paddle caches
rules.notes: Vision/NLP framework weight and iopath caches.

rules.name: Apple/system Python framework caches (user)
rules.notes: User-level Apple python cache under Library/Caches. pip covered by ml-pip-wheel-cache.

native_cleaner_hints: hf cache ls / hf cache prune / hf cache rm
uv cache clean ; uv cache prune
sources: Hugging Face hub cache docs (~/.cache/huggingface/hub, datasets, xet)
